C528/1618/2026
Harendra Singh Bedi --Applicant
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand --Respondent
Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Pankaj Semwal, learned counsel for the 
applicant.
2. Mr. Vijay Khanduri, learned Brief Holder 
for the State.
3. Dispute appears to be matrimonial one and 
learned counsel for the applicant submits that 
there are chances of amicable settlement, 
therefore, parties may be called.
4. The respondent/complainant is not 
arrayed as party/respondent. The counsel for the 
applicant is permitted to implead the 
respondent/complainant as the party/ 
respondent during course of the day and take 
fresh steps to serve the newly impleaded party 
within a week through all modes including 
whatsapp and mail so that on the next date the 
respondent shall ensure her presence for the 
purpose of settlement.
5. List this case on 10.08.2026. Both the parties 
shall remain present for their settlement.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
28-07-2026
Parul
